title: OR-KLAMATH FALLS FWO-GROUND MAINTENANCE
description: Please read the entire Request for Quotation (RFQ) and all attachments prior to submitting a quote.  Solicitation 140FF027Q0085 is issued under Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 12, including the simplified procedures at RFO 12.201-1, for grounds maintenance services at the Klamath Falls National Fish Hatchery, 3745 Lower Klamath Lake Road, Klamath Falls, OR 97603. Services shall be performed in accordance with the attached Statement of Work and service-area map.  This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside under NAICS 561730 - Landscaping Services, with a $9.5 million size standard, and PSC S208. The Government intends to issue one Firm-Fixed-Price purchase order to the responsible source whose technically acceptable quotation represents the best overall value, considering technical capability, relevant experience, and price as described in the attached B06 Offer Evaluation Information.  Anticipated Period of Performance: One base period and four one-year option periods, March 1, 2027 through February 29, 2032. Individual periods are identified in the B06 Bid Schedule. Exercise of options is at the Government¿s discretion.  Submit a completed and signed SF 1449, completed B06 Bid Schedule with pricing for all periods, and Technical Submission addressing the B06 requirements as three individual PDF files. Acknowledge any amendments, include your SAM.gov UEI and valid email address, and identify exceptions or state "None." Active SAM registration with no exclusions is required.  Submit quotations to Tanner_Frank@ios.doi.gov. The email subject line must contain "RFQ 140FF027Q0085". Telephone calls are not accepted for quotations or RFIs.  Site Visit: November 25, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. local time at the hatchery. Attendance is encouraged but optional. Coordinate in advance with Kimberly Flanagan at kimberly_flanagan@fws.gov or 541-591-3540.  Request for Information: Submit RFIs to Tanner_Frank@ios.doi.gov by November 25, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Central Time. Review the attached Solicitation Clarifications before submitting questions.  NOTICE TO PROSPECTIVE CONTRACTORS: Upon request, provide company names, supervisor names, telephone numbers, and email addresses for proposed subcontractors.  Invoicing: Submit invoices through the Invoice Processing Platform (IPP) after Government acceptance of services.  Quotes Due: November 30, 2026, at 11 a.m. Central Time.
